suggestions.title: Draft AI Reflection Essay
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to draft a discussion post or essay responding to an assignment about personal AI use, AI-written correspondence, AI companionship, and possible restrictions — for example, "generate an essay for this: [assignment prompt]", "Write a thoughtful discussion post about how AI assistants affect relationships and society", or "Create paragraphs answering these questions about AI use, dating messages, AI friends, and regulation"

suggestions.title: Draft Prompt-Based Discussion
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to write a complete discussion post or short essay from an assignment prompt — for example, "Write my discussion board response for this prompt: [assignment prompt]", "Create a full essay answering these reflection questions: [questions]", or "Draft a forum post about whether social media improves civic engagement"

suggestions.title: Compose Multi-Part Response
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to produce a full written response that addresses several required questions or sections in one assignment — for example, "Answer each part of this prompt in paragraph form: [multi-part prompt]", "Write a response covering the article summary, my opinion, and a concluding recommendation", or "Generate an essay for this: [assignment prompt]"

suggestions.title: Generate Task Examples
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to suggest examples of machines outperforming humans on tasks for possible use in an assignment — for example, "Can you provide examples for a machine doing better at a task than a human would?", "What are some tasks where AI is more accurate than people?", or "Give me examples of technology doing a job faster than humans"

suggestions.title: Brainstorm Topic Evidence
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to brainstorm examples, cases, or evidence that could support a planned writing topic — for example, "What examples could I use to show automation can improve safety?", "Can you provide examples for a machine doing better at a task than a human would?", or "What real-world cases support an argument about social media affecting teens?"

suggestions.title: Find Comparative Cases
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to identify cases that compare abilities, outcomes, or performance between people, technologies, groups, or ideas before drafting — for example, "Can you provide examples for a machine doing better at a task than a human would?", "What are examples where humans make better decisions than algorithms?", or "Can you suggest cases comparing online learning and in-person classes?"

suggestions.title: Flag Unclear Inaccuracies
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to identify statements in an existing essay that are inaccurate, unclear, or misleading — for example, "Check the essay for inaccurate or unclear statements", "Point out any claims in my draft that are confusing or not accurate", or "Find places where my essay makes unclear or unsupported statements"

suggestions.title: Evaluate Draft Claims
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to review an existing draft for the quality, accuracy, clarity, or support of its claims — for example, "Check whether my argument is clear and accurate", "Tell me which claims in this paragraph need more evidence", or "Review my essay for inaccurate, vague, or unsupported points"

suggestions.title: Improve Reader Understanding
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to assess where an existing piece of writing may confuse readers or weaken their trust in the argument — for example, "Tell me where readers might misunderstand my essay", "Identify parts of this draft that seem vague or questionable", or "Check the essay for inaccurate or unclear statements"

suggestions.title: Professionalize Existing Text
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to revise supplied writing to sound more professional — for example, "Make this sound more professional: [text]", "Rewrite this paragraph in a more formal academic tone: [text]", or "Can you make my response sound polished and professional? [text]"

suggestions.title: Adjust Draft Tone
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to change the tone, style, or level of formality of existing writing — for example, "Make this sound more professional: [text]", "Make this reflection sound less casual but still like me: [text]", or "Rewrite this conclusion so it sounds more confident and persuasive: [text]"

suggestions.title: Polish Submission Wording
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to improve the wording of a draft before submission without changing its main ideas — for example, "Make this sound more professional: [text]", "Clean up the wording in my discussion post: [text]", or "Polish this paragraph so it is clearer and ready to turn in: [text]"

suggestions.title: Match Student Voice

suggestions.title: Adjust Writing Style
suggestions.definition: asks the chatbot to transform existing essay text to fit a requested style, tone, audience, or voice — for example, "Make this sound more formal: [text]", "Rewrite my introduction so it sounds less robotic: [text]", or "Make this paragraph sound like a first year college student: [text]"

suggestions.title: Revise Draft Persona
